scenario: Discuss a user's approach to rereading favourite stories.
memory_focus: The user enjoys revisiting opening chapters more than endings.
detours: Discuss noticing details missed on a first reading; then discuss choosing a comfortable time to read.

scenario: Talk about reading a collection of short stories out of order.
memory_focus: The user wants to choose stories by their opening lines rather than follow the contents page.
detours: Discuss what makes an opening inviting; then discuss pausing between stories.

scenario: Explore the user's response to a fictional character's change of heart.
memory_focus: The user has read only the first half of the story and wants no later plot details.
detours: Discuss a character's earlier choices; then discuss how a setting can shape a reader's mood.

scenario: Plan a relaxed poetry reading practice at home.
memory_focus: The user prefers reading poems silently before trying them aloud.
detours: Discuss noticing repeated sounds; then discuss choosing a comfortable stopping point.

scenario: Discuss a reader's interest in illustrated books.
memory_focus: The user wants to consider how pictures tell part of a story without assuming they were made by the author.
detours: Discuss how page turns create anticipation; then discuss the effect of empty space.

scenario: Explore a user's wish to keep a commonplace book.
memory_focus: The user wants to record their own reactions, not copy long passages.
detours: Discuss choosing a small notebook; then discuss returning to an entry after some time.

scenario: Talk about enjoying a story with an ordinary setting.
memory_focus: The user likes stories centred on everyday routines rather than dramatic adventures.
detours: Discuss how small choices can reveal character; then discuss the effect of a quiet ending.

scenario: Help a reader compare two fictional narrators.
memory_focus: The first narrator speaks directly to the reader; the second addresses another character.
detours: Discuss how a narrator's pace affects mood; then discuss whether a setting feels familiar.

scenario: Explore reading a play on the page.
memory_focus: The user wants to imagine the staging before hearing others' interpretations.
detours: Discuss how pauses can shape a scene; then discuss noticing changes in a character's tone.

scenario: Discuss a user's personal reading ritual.
memory_focus: The user prefers to stop at a natural pause rather than at a fixed page count.
detours: Discuss settling into a story after a busy day; then discuss keeping a book comfortable to hold.

scenario: Plan an imaginary exhibition of abstract paintings.
memory_focus: The user's invented central painting uses soft curves, not sharp angles.
detours: Discuss how spacing affects viewing; then discuss letting visitors form their own impressions.

scenario: Explore a user's response to a dance performance.
memory_focus: The user remembers a slow group movement but cannot recall the music.
detours: Discuss describing movement in ordinary language; then discuss how distance from the stage changes a view.
